title: Turbulent Flame Speed Can Increase under Curvature Smoothing
summary: Curvature effects are expected to smooth flame-front wrinkles and thereby reduce turbulent flame speed. We construct a smooth three-dimensional periodic shear flow for which introducing Markstein curvature diffusivity instead increases the effective flame speed predicted by the level-set G-equation. This gives the first counterexample, within this model, to monotone slowdown under curvature smoothing and contrasts with the rigorous monotonicity result for two-dimensional shear flows.
